item.title: Bogia cut off as historic floods hit the district
item.description: Bogia District in Madang Province has been completely cut off following unprecedented flooding caused by a heavy downpour last Wednesday night, leaving vehicles stranded and commuters forced to turn back. Rain began around 9:00 pm and continued through the night, unleashing what residents describe as the worst flooding ever seen in the area. item.description: The Bougainville Community Grants Scheme (BCGS) brings together local community groups, community government leaders, and district community development officers to carry out development projects that enhance people's lives, one community at a time.
